name: skm
description: Keep agent skills and plugins in sync across machines and coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi): one store, symlinks, rsync over ssh.

scripts.build:mac: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 bin/skm.ts --outfile dist/skm-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 bin/skm.ts --outfile dist/skm-darwin-x64
scripts.build:linux: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 bin/skm.ts --outfile dist/skm-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 bin/skm.ts --outfile dist/skm-linux-arm64
